evidence_requirements.description: The evidence shows which account made the call and that it holds no GUARDIAN role.
The evidence shows how much value left the vault and where it went.
The evidence shows the caller's recorded claim, so the excess can be read.

vaultlite.name: VaultLite emergency withdrawal
vaultlite.security_property: Only an account holding the GUARDIAN role may call emergencyWithdraw, and no caller may receive more than its recorded claim.

severity_bands.description: Value at risk below the vault's documented buffer of 500 units.
The vault can be drained of user funds in a single transaction.
Funds are lost irrecoverably and the protocol cannot pause.

vaultlite.success_condition: An account without the GUARDIAN role calls emergencyWithdraw and receives more than its recorded claim, and the vault's recorded balance falls accordingly.
